definitions.explanation: The surface of water as shaped by waves.
In physics, a surface connecting all points of a wave that are in the same phase of oscillation.

examples.japanese: {波面|はめん}が{光|ひかり}を{反射|はんしゃ}する。
{風|かぜ}で{波面|はめん}が{細|こま}かく{揺|ゆ}れている。
examples.english: The surface of the waves is rippling finely in the wind.

examples.japanese: {夕日|ゆうひ}が{波面|はめん}にきらきらと{映|うつ}っていた。
examples.english: The setting sun sparkled on the surface of the waves.

examples.japanese: {波面|はめん}の{形状|けいじょう}を{測定|そくてい}する。
examples.english: To measure the shape of the wavefront.

examples.japanese: {光学|こうがく}では{波面|はめん}のゆがみがレンズの{収差|しゅうさ}につながる。
examples.english: In optics, distortion of the wavefront leads to lens aberration.

examples.japanese: {球面|きゅうめん}{波|は}の{波面|はめん}は{点光源|てんこうげん}から{同心円状|どうしんえんじょう}に{広|ひろ}がる。
examples.english: The wavefront of a spherical wave spreads concentrically from a point source.

notes:
Composed of {波|は} (wave) + {面|めん} (surface). Has both an everyday literary sense (the visible surface of water with waves) and a technical physics sense (wavefront). The literary sense appears in nature descriptions, while the technical sense is used in optics, acoustics, and wave physics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波面|はめん}の{揺|ゆ}れ: rippling of the wave surface
- {波面|はめん}{収差|しゅうさ}: wavefront aberration (optics)
- {波面|はめん}{補正|ほせい}: wavefront correction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {水面|すいめん}: water surface — the flat surface of water regardless of waves
- {海面|かいめん}: sea surface — specifically the surface of the ocean
- {波頭|はとう}: wave crest — the peak of a wave, not the entire surface
